lines.en: I shift slowly through the dark
Not a sliver of light comes through the cracks
I slide along the cave wall
There is no sound underfoot
The place I pass grows darker
My shadow melts into the rock seam

lines.zh: 我停在洞里最深的拐角
lines.en: I stop at the deepest corner of the cave
My steps leave no trace
Water drips from above, I do not flinch
I head for the darker depths

lines.zh: 我的身体贴着石面过去
lines.en: My body passes flush with the stone

lines.zh: 我在洞道里一段段推进
lines.en: I advance through the tunnel in stretches
I stand without breathing
The dark wraps me tightly
I stare at a point ahead
I will not move unless you go
The water on the rock keeps a steady rhythm
I look like a standing stone
No light reaches here

lines.zh: 我的手指垂着，一动不动
lines.en: My fingers hang, perfectly still
I am waiting for the dark to go on
The air in here is cold and thick
I press myself very flat

lines.zh: 我数着水滴落下的次数
lines.en: I count the water drops

lines.zh: 我把背靠上冰冷的岩壁
lines.en: I lean my back on the cold rock
My breathing makes no sound
You are staring at me
You have looked too long
I can feel your gaze
One second from now I will be gone
You are raising your torch
Do not turn that torch here

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在黑暗里很亮
lines.en: Your eyes are bright in the dark
One step closer and I vanish
I do not like being seen

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在这洞里太响了
lines.en: Your breathing is too loud in this cave
Are you counting my outline
My face has no expression
I know what you are thinking
The light in your hand is shaking
You should not have brought light in
I only keep looking at you

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着这一片黑
lines.en: This patch of black stands between us

lines.zh: 你的光在我脸上停了一下
lines.en: Your light rested on my face a moment

lines.zh: 我受伤了，但你看不见血
lines.en: I am hurt, but you cannot see blood

lines.zh: 三十点生命在一点点掉
lines.en: Thirty health slips away bit by bit
My shape flickered
The light grew a little brighter
I retreat deeper in
That made it harder to hold myself together
I feel myself fading

lines.zh: 疼对我是很陌生的东西
lines.en: Pain is very strange to me
I press against the rock wall
I can barely stay standing
In the dark, I only watch; I don't eat.
I need nothing from this cave
What are you holding it up for
I did not even raise a hand
Such things do not concern me
Take that thing farther off

lines.zh: 黑暗里没有食物这回事
lines.en: In the dark there is no such thing as food
Your hand stands out in the light
I will not come closer for that
Leaving it on the ground does not help
You touched me just now
I recoil one step at once
This should not have happened

lines.zh: 你的温度传到我这来了
lines.en: Your warmth reached me
Within four blocks I am gone
We should not be this close
I shrink back to the rock wall
What you hit was only cold
I retreat faster than you think
That touch makes it harder to stay
I am the only one in this cave

lines.zh: 这种事不会发生在黑暗里
lines.en: Such things do not happen in the dark
No kin of mine are in this cave
I only learned how to wait

lines.zh: 你问的东西我答不上来
lines.en: I cannot answer what you asked

lines.zh: 我的存在本来就不该被追问
lines.en: My existence should not be questioned
I stand here, and that is enough
When the light comes, nothing remains
I shake my head, slowly
Say no more about it

lines.zh: 这个洞里的东西都很冷
lines.en: Everything in this cave is cold
I hold it in my hand

lines.zh: 石头落地的声音我听见了
lines.en: I heard the stone hit the ground

lines.zh: 我碰过的东西，都留在原地。
lines.en: Whatever I touch stays where it was.

lines.zh: 我的手指碰了一下就收
lines.en: My fingers touch it and withdraw
It has no temperature in my palm
I do not need it, but I picked it up

lines.zh: 洞底的东西都属于黑暗
lines.en: What lies on the cave floor belongs to the dark
I grip it until my fingers pale
You entered my cave
You carry light, it is unpleasant
I stay still and wait for you to leave
From here I can see you clearly
I have fixed on your shadow
The tunnel has only one exit
I am counting your distance
A few blocks more and I must leave
Do not raise what you hold

lines.zh: 你手里的光让我不舒服
lines.en: The light in your hand makes me uneasy
If I move, my outline scatters

lines.zh: 我不确定你算不算威胁
lines.en: I am not sure if you count as a threat
I stand here and judge you

lines.zh: 我看着你的每一个动作
lines.en: I watch every movement you make

lines.zh: 你在犹豫要不要照过来
lines.en: You are deciding whether to shine it here
I stay motionless and let you choose first
The light is only one step from me
I count the stones you break
The closer you come, the thinner I get
I know this cave better than you
I make no sound, you cannot hear me
You are looking for me in the dark

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候我就没了
lines.en: The moment you look up, I am gone
My outline is beginning to blur

lines.zh: 再等一会，你就会怀疑自己
lines.en: Wait a moment more and you will doubt yourself
You lowered the torch a little
I am the only one in this cave
I am waiting for the light to turn elsewhere
Each step you take thins me
I do not want to vanish yet

lines.zh: 石头上的水滴得越来越慢
lines.en: The dripping on the stone slows

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的位置
lines.en: Your shadow falls where I stand
I raise a hand and stop it in midair
I am not attacking you
This hand only wanted to touch once
I reach out and pull back
You will not be hurt by this
I have never struck anyone
My fingers pass through the dark

lines.zh: 你退开的时候我也退了
lines.en: When you backed off, I backed off too
This is not an attack, it is goodbye
I only put out one finger

lines.zh: 我伸手挡了一下你的光
lines.en: I reach out to block your light

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，几乎没有力气
lines.en: This one is light, almost without force

lines.zh: 我把你手里的东西推开
lines.en: I push aside what you are holding
My movement is slower than the dark
Just step back a few paces
I did not mean to hurt you

lines.zh: 我在最黑的角落里出现
lines.en: I appear in the darkest corner

lines.zh: 这里的方块光照不到我
lines.en: The block light here does not reach me
I stand before the cave wall, very thin
You brought a torch in
I have only thirty health
The dark lets me stay a while
I make no sound at all
The tunnel is straight, I can see you
I grow out of the seam in the stone
This underground is mine
You will walk a long way to get out
My shadow is darker than the wall
I float out of the rock seam
The cave dark has one more layer
I am some distance from you

lines.zh: 你的火光先照到了我的脚
lines.en: Your firelight reached my feet first
Once the light rises above two, I'm gone.
The rock wall remembers my shape
I make no sound whatever
I keep the dark here

lines.zh: 火把的光和热一起烧过来
lines.en: The torch brings light and heat at once
I slid down the rock face

lines.zh: 地下暗河灌进我的身体
lines.en: The underground river poured through me

lines.zh: 爆炸把洞穴的黑暗都炸开了
lines.en: The blast tore the cave's darkness apart

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我，留下一个空洞
lines.en: An arrow passed through me, leaving a hollow

lines.zh: 那股术力在黑暗里格外刺骨
lines.en: That magic stings sharply in the dark

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，所以这感觉很奇怪
lines.en: I do not eat, so this feeling is strange

lines.zh: 雷光把整个洞穴照得雪白
lines.en: Lightning lit the whole cave white

lines.zh: 黑暗变成了空洞的黑暗
lines.en: The dark became an empty dark
